items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: There was also the Vancouver Jazz Festival when Ken Pickering was alive, he just brought in everyone you know, from North America, from overseas, all the interesting music he heard in the world he just brought it all in.

ctx.x: We almost are. And I wish that, I hope things open up for you as for all artists and they can get back to the work at hand. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

Thank you. You know could I say one more thing about the arts in this country — and I know I’m going to think of a million more things I wish I had said after this is over — but like I said there is a network of places, like the Outpost in Albuquerque, Tom Guralnick’s place. There are things happening everywhere and especially, especially important I think is what William and Patricia Parker have been doing in New York with the Vision Festival. I think that is really one of our most significant festivals, maybe…
Thank you. Well I appreciate the conversation today and I hope you go to your piano and write something new today.
